022public class FireBest extends BaseCommandPlugin {
023
024
025        protected InteractionDialogAPI dialog;
026        protected Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap;
027        protected List<Token> params;
028        protected String ruleId;
029        protected boolean keepOptions = false;
030
031        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
032                
033//              MemoryAPI mem = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
034//              if (mem != null) {
035//                      mem.unset("$personnelOfficerTimeout");
036//              }
037                
038                this.ruleId = ruleId;
039                this.dialog = dialog;
040                this.params = params;
041                this.memoryMap = memoryMap;
042                String trigger = params.get(0).string;
043                if (params.get(0).isVariable()) {
044                        VarAndMemory var = params.get(0).getVarNameAndMemory(memoryMap);
045                        trigger = var.memory.getString(var.name);
046                }
047                if (params.size() > 1) {
048                        keepOptions = params.get(1).getBoolean(memoryMap);
049                }
050                
051                RulesAPI rules = Global.getSector().getRules();
052                RuleAPI rule = rules.getBestMatching(ruleId, trigger, dialog, memoryMap);
053                
054                if (rule == null) return false;
055                
056                applyRule(rule);
057                
058                return true;
059        }
060        
061        public static boolean fire(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap, String params) {
062                return new FireBest().execute(ruleId, dialog, Misc.tokenize(params), memoryMap);
063        }
064        
065        private void applyRule(RuleAPI rule) {
066//              if (!rule.getOptions().isEmpty()) {
067//                      dialog.getOptionPanel().clearOptions();
068//                      for (Option option : rule.getOptions()) {
069//                              dialog.getOptionPanel().addOption(option.text, option.id, null);
070//                      }
071//                      if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
072//                              DumpMemory.addOption(dialog);
073//                      }
074//              }
075                
076                List<OptionAdder> options = new ArrayList<OptionAdder>();
077                for (Option option : rule.getOptions()) {
078                        if (option.id.startsWith("(dev)") && !Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) continue;
079                        options.add(new OptionAdder(option));
080                }
081                for (ExpressionAPI e : rule.getScriptCopy()) {
082                        if (e.doesCommandAddOptions()) {
083                                options.add(new OptionAdder(e));
084                        }
085                }
086                
087                if (!options.isEmpty()) {
088                        Collections.sort(options, new Comparator<OptionAdder>() {
089                                public int compare(OptionAdder o1, OptionAdder o2) {
090                                        float diff = o1.getOrder(memoryMap) - o2.getOrder(memoryMap);
091                                        if (diff < 0) return -1;
092                                        if (diff > 0) return 1;
093                                        return 0;
094                                }
095                        });
096                        
097                        if (!keepOptions) {
098                                dialog.getOptionPanel().clearOptions();
099                        }
100                        for (OptionAdder option : options) {
101                                option.add(ruleId, dialog, params, memoryMap);
102                        }
103                        if (!keepOptions) {
104                                if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
105                                        DevMenuOptions.addOptions(dialog);
106                                }
107                        }
108                }               
109                
110                addText(rule.getId(), rule.pickText());
111                rule.runScript(dialog, memoryMap);
112        }
113        
114        private void addText(String ruleId, String text) {
115                if (text == null || text.isEmpty()) return;
116
117                
118                text = Global.getSector().getRules().performTokenReplacement(ruleId, text, dialog.getInteractionTarget(), memoryMap);
119//              Map<String, String> tokens = Global.getSector().getRules().getTokenReplacements(ruleId, dialog.getInteractionTarget(), memoryMap);
120//              for (String token : tokens.keySet()) {
121//                      String value = tokens.get(token);
122//                      text = text.replaceAll("(?s)\\" + token, value);
123//              }
124//              
125//              text = Misc.replaceTokensFromMemory(text, memoryMap);
126                
127                dialog.getTextPanel().addParagraph(text);
128        }
129}
